summary:
Full run results from egarch_vs_garch.py on SPY 2015-2026:
- 2,890 trading days, kurtosis 14.44 (extreme fat tails)
- EGARCH Student-t wins AIC/BIC vs GARCH and vs Normal EGARCH
- Leverage effect (gamma = -0.179, p < 0.0001) definitively confirmed
- OOS test period (Jan-Jul 2026): GARCH wins on RMSE by 4.56%
- Key insight: EGARCH has superior in-sample fit (AIC 7147 vs 7466) but the H1 2026 test window was an unusual symmetric-shock regime
- Chart saved as egarch_vs_garch.png
